The '''balo mushroom''' was a [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] grown on [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]], for use in production of [[ixetal cilona]] extract, used in [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]]. They were grown in large numbers in underground farms of Balosar. Although unconfirmed, it was possible that [[Sebolto]] grew his own mushrooms on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], which would explain how he was able to produce death sticks. During the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], balo mushrooms farms were threatened by the encroaching pollution from the surface of Balosar.
